watch.name: lexical-terms-that-flood-the-judge
watch.nl_query: Tell me when someone replies to me about anything at all.

nodes.comment: A lexical arm is for terms rare enough that the judge almost never wakes. Every term here fails that in a different way: one is punctuation that normalizes away and would match everything, one is common enough to be worth a second look, and one is in a third of the corpus.

judge.proposition: This is a reply to the user
